BEYOND THE FILM / THE CLINIC

Specialist care.
Human understanding.

Asha Maxillofacial and Dental Super Speciality Hospital brings comprehensive dental care and specialist expertise together in Akola.

Led by experienced clinicians, the practice approaches each patient through careful assessment, clear explanation and an individual treatment plan. The environment is designed to support calm conversations as much as precise clinical work.

02Root Canal TreatmentRestorative dentistry

Root canal treatment addresses infection or inflammation inside a tooth. The goal is to treat the affected area, preserve the natural tooth where clinically appropriate and plan its restoration.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Before your
first visit.

How do I book an appointment?

Use the form below, call the clinic on +91 72762 09022, or send a WhatsApp appointment request.

What should I bring?

Bring any relevant dental records, medication information and previous imaging you may have. The team can advise if anything else is needed.

Will I receive a treatment plan?

Recommendations follow a clinical assessment. The dentist will explain findings and suitable options before treatment proceeds.

Are treatment results guaranteed?

No medical or dental outcome can be guaranteed. Individual results depend on clinical circumstances and ongoing care.
